description: Catalog of all Bit Tool module APIs for side-feature integration in host applications (e.g. Cliks Business). Login APIs are excluded.

authentication.source: Supplied directly by host application auth session

endpoints.name: Get Paginated Contacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves paginated contacts with optional keyword search.

endpoints.name: Get All Contacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves complete contacts collection across integrated workspaces.

endpoints.name: Get Contact by ID
endpoints.description: Retrieves single contact details by ID.

endpoints.name: Create Contact
endpoints.description: Creates a new contact record.

endpoints.name: Update Contact
endpoints.description: Updates contact record fields.

endpoints.name: Delete Contact
endpoints.description: Deletes contact record by ID.

endpoints.name: Get Notes
endpoints.description: Retrieves user notes, including notes created across other apps.

endpoints.name: Get Note by ID
endpoints.description: Retrieves full note content by ID.

endpoints.name: Create Note
endpoints.description: Creates a new note.

endpoints.name: Update Note
endpoints.description: Updates note title, body, pinned, or archive state.

endpoints.name: Delete Note
endpoints.description: Deletes note record by ID.

endpoints.name: Get Categories
endpoints.description: Lists all event categories and colors.

endpoints.name: Create Category
endpoints.description: Creates a new category for calendar events.

endpoints.name: Get Month Events
endpoints.description: Fetches events for the specified month and year.

endpoints.name: Create Event
endpoints.description: Schedules a new calendar event.

endpoints.name: Update Event
endpoints.description: Updates calendar event details or timings.

endpoints.name: Delete Event
endpoints.description: Deletes a calendar event.

endpoints.name: Get Reminders
endpoints.description: Fetches reminders for a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD).

endpoints.name: Create Reminder
endpoints.description: Creates a new reminder.

endpoints.name: Update Reminder
endpoints.description: Updates reminder details.

endpoints.name: Complete Reminder
endpoints.description: Marks a reminder as completed.

endpoints.name: Delete Reminder
endpoints.description: Deletes a reminder.

endpoints.name: Get Date Notes
endpoints.description: Fetches date-linked notes for a date.

endpoints.name: Create Date Note
endpoints.description: Creates a date-linked note.

endpoints.name: Update Date Note
endpoints.description: Updates date-linked note content.

endpoints.name: Delete Date Note
endpoints.description: Deletes date-linked note.

endpoints.name: Search Calendar
endpoints.description: Global search across events, reminders, and date notes.

endpoints.name: Get Calculator History
endpoints.description: Fetches saved calculation tape sessions.

endpoints.name: Get Cross-App History
endpoints.description: Fetches calculation sessions from all integrated apps.

endpoints.name: Get Session by ID
endpoints.description: Retrieves calculation session with full tape item list.

endpoints.name: Create Session
endpoints.description: Creates a new calculation tape session.

endpoints.name: Add Tape Item
endpoints.description: Appends a tape operation to a calculation session.

endpoints.name: Delete Session
endpoints.description: Deletes calculation session by ID.

endpoints.name: Clear All Sessions
endpoints.description: Clears all standard calculator sessions.

endpoints.name: Get Compare History
endpoints.description: Fetches comparison sessions.

endpoints.name: Create Compare Session
endpoints.description: Creates a new price comparison session.

endpoints.name: Add Compare Item
endpoints.description: Adds a comparison row between Side A and Side B.

endpoints.name: Update Compare Item
endpoints.description: Updates row values, quantities, or discounts.

endpoints.name: Delete Compare Item
endpoints.description: Deletes comparison row.

endpoints.name: Delete Compare Session
endpoints.description: Deletes compare session.

endpoints.name: Clear All Compare History
endpoints.description: Clears all price comparison sessions.

endpoints.name: Get Notifications
endpoints.description: Fetches all notifications for the authenticated user.

endpoints.name: Mark One Notification Read
endpoints.description: Marks a single notification as read.

endpoints.name: Mark All Notifications Read
endpoints.description: Marks all notifications as read.

endpoints.name: Get Weather Forecast
endpoints.description: Live weather conditions and multi-day forecast.

endpoints.name: Reverse Geocoding
endpoints.description: Resolves GPS coordinates to city name and country.

endpoints.name: Get Supported Currencies
endpoints.description: Lists all supported global currencies.

endpoints.name: Get Live Exchange Rate
endpoints.description: Fetches current exchange rate between currencies.

endpoints.name: Get Authenticated User Profile
endpoints.description: Fetches current user profile, role, and organization context using the host app's bearer token. (Login API excluded).
